title: execution.trade-event.v1
description: SKELETON, not yet wired into any service (docs/adr/007-shared-cross-service-contracts.md). Target Kafka replacement for today's real, live auto_trade:events Redis stream that ctrader-engine publishes to and algo-bot's execution/delivery layer consumes from — the event `type` values below (order_filled, take_profit, stop_moved, position_closed, ...) are the real type strings observed on that live stream, not invented names. ctrader-engine never decides trade validity (docs/architecture/service-boundaries.md) — every event here is a fact about what already happened at the broker.

type.description: Not exhaustive — the real stream has more types observed live this session (e.g. account_capability, ready, config_health, warning are operational, not trade events, and would not belong on this schema at all).
